parameters.query:
with candidate as materialized (
  select
    ci.content_id,
    ci.title,
    ci.category,
    ci.status,
    ci.source_payload_json,
    sb.storyboard_json,
    coalesce(sb.style_notes, '') as style_notes,
    coalesce(s.selected_hook, '') as selected_hook,
    coalesce(s.narration_script, '') as narration_script,
    coalesce(d.director_json, '{}'::jsonb) as director_json
  from content_items ci
  join storyboards sb on sb.content_id = ci.content_id
  join scripts s on s.content_id = ci.content_id
  left join directors d on d.content_id = ci.content_id
  where ci.status in ('validation_complete', 'storyboard_complete')
  order by ci.updated_at asc
  limit 1
), claim as (
  update content_items ci
  set status = 'generating_assets',
      updated_at = now()
  where ci.content_id = (select content_id from candidate)
    and ci.status in ('validation_complete', 'storyboard_complete')
  returning ci.content_id
)
select
  c.content_id,
  c.title,
  c.category,
  c.status,
  c.source_payload_json,
  c.storyboard_json,
  c.style_notes,
  c.selected_hook,
  c.narration_script,
  c.director_json
from candidate c
join claim cl on cl.content_id = c.content_id;

with deleted as (
  delete from assets
  where content_id = '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid
    and asset_role in ('scene_image', 'scene_video')
), inserted as (
  insert into assets (
    content_id,
    scene_number,
    asset_role,
    provider,
    source_url,
    storage_url,
    mime_type,
    duration_seconds,
    width,
    height,
    status,
    metadata_json
  )
  values
  {{$json.asset_values_sql}}
  returning 1
)
select
  '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid as content_id,
  'scene_image+scene_video' as asset_role,
  count(*)::int as asset_count
from inserted;

update content_items
set status = 'assets_ready',
    updated_at = now()
where content_id = '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Scene Asset SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid
returning content_id, title, status, updated_at;

insert into workflow_runs (
  content_id,
  workflow_name,
  run_status,
  started_at,
  ended_at,
  duration_ms,
  error_message,
  details_json
)
values (
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Scene Asset SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid,
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Scene Asset SQL Values"].json["workflow_name_sql"]}}',
  'success',
  '{{$item(0).$node["Parse Scene Asset Result"].json["run_started_at"]}}'::timestamptz,
  now(),
  {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Scene Asset SQL Values"].json["duration_ms_sql"]}},
  null,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'generation_model', nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Parse Scene Asset Result"].json["generation_model"]}}', ''),
    'rehost_provider', nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Parse Scene Asset Result"].json["rehost_provider"]}}', ''),
    'scene_asset_generation', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Scene Asset SQL Values"].json["scene_asset_summary_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb,
    'cost', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Scene Asset SQL Values"].json["cost_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb
  )
)
returning run_id, workflow_name, run_status, ended_at;
